title: Provider building blocks
description: Definitions shared by the external provider schemas (additive plan sections 5, 6, 11 and 15), referenced as urn:alixai:schema:providers:shared:v1#/$defs/<name>. This file is a definitions library: it constrains nothing on its own. It depends on nothing outside schemas/common. Object defs label every property with x-alixai-authority by true origin: modelRef is all host (operator supplied), subject all alixai (taken from the verified Scope), providerRef mixes alixai and host members and is used only under alixai containers. Secrets never appear in any provider schema: there is no member that holds a key, a token or a password, only opaque references and masked fingerprints.

providerId.title: Provider ID
providerId.description: The stable slug of a hosted provider (openai, anthropic, gemini, meta-llama, ...). Lower case, 1 to 32 characters, never a URL or a path.

modelId.title: Model ID
modelId.description: The provider-side model identifier exactly as the provider names it. 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits and . _ : + - ; never a path or a URL.

modelVersion.title: Model version
modelVersion.description: The pinned version or snapshot of a model (for example a dated snapshot id). A profile is bound to this exact value: a changed model version resets qualification (ADR-0028).

profileId.title: Provider profile ID
profileId.description: ID of one provider and model profile in the registry. Minted by the AlixAI core: prefix pprf, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case). The prefix is inside the 2 to 8 letter range of common ids typedId.

credentialRefId.title: Credential reference ID
credentialRefId.description: Opaque ID of a credential held by the credential service. It names a secret; it never contains one. Minted by the AlixAI core: prefix cred, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case). The prefix is inside the 2 to 8 letter range of common ids typedId.

egressPolicyId.title: Egress policy ID
egressPolicyId.description: ID of one data-egress policy at one level. Minted by the AlixAI core: prefix epol, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case). The prefix is inside the 2 to 8 letter range of common ids typedId.

egressDecisionId.title: Egress decision ID
egressDecisionId.description: ID of one egress decision. Minted by the AlixAI core: prefix edec, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case). The prefix is inside the 2 to 8 letter range of common ids typedId.

envelopeId.title: Request envelope ID
envelopeId.description: ID of one request envelope. Minted by the AlixAI core: prefix envl, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case). The prefix is inside the 2 to 8 letter range of common ids typedId.

usageId.title: Usage record ID
usageId.description: ID of one usage record. Minted by the AlixAI core: prefix usg, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case). The prefix is inside the 2 to 8 letter range of common ids typedId.

budgetId.title: Budget ID
budgetId.description: ID of one budget. Minted by the AlixAI core: prefix bud, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case). The prefix is inside the 2 to 8 letter range of common ids typedId.

reservationId.title: Budget reservation ID
reservationId.description: ID of one budget reservation (reserve, settle, release). Minted by the AlixAI core: prefix rsv, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case). The prefix is inside the 2 to 8 letter range of common ids typedId.

reportId.title: Conformance report ID
reportId.description: ID of one provider conformance report. Minted by the AlixAI core: prefix conf, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case). The prefix is inside the 2 to 8 letter range of common ids typedId.

acknowledgementId.title: Billing notice acknowledgement ID
acknowledgementId.description: ID of one billing notice acknowledgement. Minted by the AlixAI core: prefix ack, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case). The prefix is inside the 2 to 8 letter range of common ids typedId.

privateEndpointId.title: Private LLM endpoint ID
privateEndpointId.description: ID of one private self-hosted LLM endpoint (ADR 0045). Minted by the AlixAI core or supplied by the operator on PUT: prefix ple, an underscore and a 26-character ULID (Crockford base32, upper case). The prefix is inside the 2 to 8 letter range of common ids typedId.

privateLlmLifecycle.title: Private LLM endpoint lifecycle
privateLlmLifecycle.description: Lifecycle of a private self-hosted endpoint (ADR 0045). The host provisioner and AlixAI health checks set it. warming/provisioning refuse turns with private_llm_starting; failed/stopped/draining with private_llm_unavailable; ready serves.

privateEndpointOwnerKind.title: Private endpoint owner kind
privateEndpointOwnerKind.description: Who may use a private endpoint: principal (one account), tenant (pin or principals of that tenant), or shared (many principals; context stays per tenant).

fileId.title: File ID
fileId.description: Opaque ID of a scoped file reference. Same grammar as urn:alixai:schema:actions:shared:v1#/$defs/fileId, repeated here so the providers area depends on common only. It is not a path and never resolves to one.

sourceId.title: Source ID
sourceId.description: ID of a registered RAG source. Same grammar as urn:alixai:schema:actions:shared:v1#/$defs/sourceId, repeated here so the providers area depends on common only.

microUnits.title: Micro-units
microUnits.description: A non-negative amount of money in integer micro-units of the operator currency (1 000 000 micro-units = one unit of that currency). Never a float. Capped at 2^53-1 so every JSON implementation represents it exactly.

counter.title: Counter
counter.description: A non-negative whole number (a count of requests, toks, images, seconds or bytes) capped at 2^53-1.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The operator currency of every micro-unit amount: three upper case letters (an ISO 4217 code, or a three letter code the operator defines for credits).

regionCode.title: Region code
regionCode.description: A lower case geographic or residency code: global, a two letter country or area code (us, eu, de), optionally followed by up to three hyphenated sub-region parts (us-east, eu-west-1). The literal unknown is deliberately NOT a region code: an unknown region is stated with residency unknown in a provider profile and is never allowed by a policy (ADR-0026).

sha256.title: SHA-256 digest
sha256.description: sha256: followed by 64 lower-case hex digits.

reasonCode.title: Reason code
reasonCode.description: A fixed machine-readable reason: lower snake_case, never free text and never a quotation of user input or provider output.

egressMode.title: Egress mode
egressMode.description: What a RAG source may contribute to an external request (additive plan section 8). local_only: never send content externally (the default). allow_excerpt: send only bounded, authorised excerpts. allow_metadata: send titles, IDs and status but no content. deny: exclude the source from the AlixAI capability entirely. Restrictiveness, most restrictive first: deny, local_only, allow_metadata, allow_excerpt. The effective mode is the most restrictive along the chain deployment, application, tenant, workspace, source.

egressLevel.title: Egress policy level
egressLevel.description: The level an egress policy applies at (additive plan section 6), widest first: deployment, application, tenant, workspace, source.

deploymentMode.title: Deployment mode
deploymentMode.description: The product mode of additive plan section 2. local is the default; external and hybrid are opt-in. Switching it never changes the host application integration contract.

role.title: External provider role
role.description: A role an external provider profile may serve. The decision-scorer role (router, master plan section 8.5) is deliberately absent: external providers never receive decision requests, so a profile cannot declare it. Mapping to the local registry roles: conversational_controller is conversational-controller, embedding, stt and tts keep their names.

accountMode.title: Credential mode
accountMode.description: How a catalog or registry profile obtains a credential (ADR 0041). tenant: the 1.1 operator/tenant binding. per_principal: the profile carries no credential; each principal binds their own. deployment_local: local models, no per-scope choice.

principalLlmRole.title: Principal LLM role
principalLlmRole.description: Roles a principal may bind to a catalog profile (ADR 0041, extended by ADR 0043 for tts). Each role resolves independently.

providerVoiceId.title: Provider voice id
providerVoiceId.description: A provider's voice identifier for TTS (ADR 0043). Never a path, URL or secret.

speechLanguage.title: Speech language tag
speechLanguage.description: A BCP 47 language tag for STT or TTS (ADR 0043), such as en, it or it-IT.

reservedPrincipalCredentialTenant.title: Reserved principal-credential tenant
reservedPrincipalCredentialTenant.description: The frozen credential-ref.binding.tenant_id value used for principal-owned credentials (ADR 0041). Not a company tenant; never used for sessions or RAG.

modality.title: Modality
modality.description: An input or output modality of a model.

meterUnit.title: Meter unit
meterUnit.description: What usage, quotas and prices are counted in. toks_in and toks_out are the model input and output counters (named toks, never tokens: the log redactor matches the substring token in key names). toks_in_cached is the part of toks_in served from a provider cache. characters_in counts input characters for character-priced speech (ADR 0043). audio_seconds_* are seconds of audio; file_bytes_in is bytes of file content; requests counts calls.

channel.title: Budget channel
channel.description: interactive: a user is waiting. background: queued work such as RAG indexing. Background work has its own budget and quota and cannot consume the interactive one (additive plan section 11.2).

sendCategory.title: Sendable data category
sendCategory.description: A category of data that can be placed in an external request. There is no category for credentials, raw application database content, filesystem paths, database handles or MCP URLs: those are not sendable and have no representation in a request envelope (see blockedCategory).

blockedCategory.title: Never-sent data category
blockedCategory.description: A category of data that never leaves the deployment (additive plan section 6.1 and 6.2). The egress guard finds and removes these from a candidate request and records the category, never the content.

retentionMode.title: Provider data retention
retentionMode.description: How long the provider keeps request content, as the provider states it. zero: not retained at all (zero data retention). transient: held only to serve the request. limited: retained for a stated number of days. indefinite: retained without a stated limit. unknown: the provider has not said; policy treats it as the most restrictive value.

trainingUse.title: Provider training use
trainingUse.description: Whether the provider may train on request content, as the provider states it. never: contractually not used. opt_in_only: used only if the account opts in. by_default: used unless the account opts out. unknown: not stated; policy treats it as the most restrictive value.

residency.title: Data residency
residency.description: How the provider places processing. pinned: processed in the listed regions only. selectable: the account chooses among the listed regions. global: processed anywhere. unknown: not stated. An unknown or global residency never satisfies a policy that lists allowed regions unless global is listed explicitly (ADR-0026).

budgetStatus.title: Budget status
budgetStatus.description: ok: under the warning threshold. warning: at or past the warning threshold. exhausted: a hard stop has been reached and no external call is made.

providerErrorKind.title: Provider error kind
providerErrorKind.description: The normalised failure of a provider call. Each kind maps to exactly one platform error code (see provider-error): authentication_failed, permission_denied, rate_limited, quota_exceeded, timeout, unavailable, bad_request, context_too_large, content_filtered, unsupported_modality, model_not_found, malformed_response, connection_lost (the request may or may not have reached the provider), internal.

profileLifecycle.title: Profile lifecycle
profileLifecycle.description: candidate: registered, not yet qualified. qualified: production-qualified (bound credential, acknowledged billing notice, passed conformance report for the exact model version). quarantined: held for review, with a reason. retired: no longer used.

credentialKind.title: Credential kind
credentialKind.description: oauth: browser-based OAuth authorization that yields access and refresh tokens (preferred whenever the provider supports it). api_key: manual API key or token entry, a fallback for providers or deployments without a suitable OAuth flow. oauth_issued_key: the user completed a browser OAuth (or PKCE) login and the provider issued a user-controlled API key rather than access/refresh tokens (for example OpenRouter); connection status can say connected via browser login without claiming a refreshable OAuth token pair.

connectionWarning.title: Connection warning
connectionWarning.description: A condition of a provider connection the operator and the host must see. broader_than_oauth_scopes: a manual key may grant broader access than OAuth scopes. excessive_permissions_reported and unsupported_account_policy: the provider reported them and the connection is quarantined. expiring_soon and rotation_overdue: rotation is due.

safeAccount.title: Safe account identifiers
safeAccount.description: Provider-assigned identifiers of the account a credential acts for, safe to show to the host application: never an e-mail address, a name or a secret. Null members are not known.

budgetSubject.title: Budget subject
budgetSubject.description: What a budget applies to: one provider, or a tenant, workspace or principal (additive plan section 11.2, ADR 0041), each optionally narrowed to one provider. The ids a kind needs are required and no id wider or narrower than the kind is allowed, so a tenant budget cannot name a workspace. Kind principal_application (1.3) is application-wide for one principal across every tenant: it names application_id and principal_id only (the service refuses tenant_id and workspace_id on that kind).

kind.description: provider, tenant, workspace, principal, or principal_application (across tenants).

provider_id.description: The provider. Required for a provider budget; narrows the others when present.

allOf.description: A provider budget names the provider and nothing narrower.
A tenant budget names application and tenant and nothing narrower.
A workspace budget names application, tenant and workspace and nothing narrower.
A principal budget names application, tenant, workspace and principal.

modelRef.title: Model reference
modelRef.description: A provider and model pair as an operator writes it in an allowlist. The version is pinned in the provider profile, not here.

providerRef.title: Provider reference
providerRef.description: The exact provider, model and version a record is about, plus the profile that carried them. Assembled by the core from the profile.

model_version.description: The pinned model version, from the profile.

subject.title: Request subject
subject.description: The verified context a record is about: a trimmed copy of the Scope with no roles or capability scopes. Every member is taken from the verified Scope by the core.
